answer: Bind each identity to a verifiable delay function: a strictly sequential computation no parallelism can shorten, run unbroken from the horizon of its first epoch onward. Like yarrow that thickens only stalk by stalk across the seasons, a VDF clock advances one irreducible step at a time, and the delta between a true seat and a clone is wall-clock sequential work that cannot be forked. Spin up a thousand copies and each still needs its own uninterrupted serial engine ticking in real time, so N seats cost N dedicated clocks, never one shared sprint.
